correctness.rationale: All 12 exact minima (RS/PF n=2,4,8,16,32,64) independently re-proved with fresh checker distinct from solver.py: words re-derived from committed definitions (RS parity-of-11-blocks; PF odd-part-mod-4) and match DRAFT 64-bit prefixes and OEIS A020985/A014577; each witness cover-checked by exact tuple-factor enumeration (no hashing); exhaustive hitting-set search proved no smaller attractor exists (e.g. RS64 k=7 UNSAT over 1730 factors, 66389 nodes; PF64 k=4 UNSAT, 2654 nodes). All witnesses lie in [0,n-1]. Exact D totals match results.json and verify.log (RS64 1730, PF64 1631, RS1024 450528, PF1024 410351). Greedy UB sets spot-checked exactly to n=256 (RS128/256, PF128/256 cover OK); remaining UBs to 1024 rely on verify.py exact-string replay (VERIFY ALL OK) using same definitions. Discovery-time hashing is not load-bearing for proof (suffix-array + exact-string verifier). Lower/per-length bounds are auxiliary and consistent (opt>=LB everywhere). No infinite dichotomy or uniform constant claimed; DRAFT Sec.3/6 explicitly labels growth trend as conjecture.

originality.rationale: Nearest prior Schaeffer-Shallit arXiv:2012.06840 (verified abstract) settles only period-doubling (size 2, n>=2), Thue-Morse (eventually 4), Tribonacci (size 3)/vtm plus Theta(1)-vs-Theta(log n) decidability; contains no RS or paperfolding attractor constants or sides. Live arXiv phrase searches for 'string attractor Rudin-Shapiro' and 'string attractor paperfolding' return zero results (replicated). OEIS A020985 (RS), A014577-adjacent A337120, and A005943 record only word definitions and factor-complexity counts (RS 8n-8 n>=8; PF 4n n>=7), a distinct invariant that does not mechanically imply attractor spans or witnesses. No prior source records gamma* values 1,2,2,4,5,8 (RS) / 1,2,2,3,4,5 (PF) for dyadic prefixes or the stated UB sets. Claim changes invariant family from p(n) to attractor spans/cover certificates, not a parameter substitution.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of specific natural objects: minimal string-attractor sizes with explicit witnessing position sets for dyadic prefixes (n<=64) of the two canonical binary 2-automatic words left open after period-doubling/TM/Tribonacci (RS and regular paperfolding), plus exact-checked UB sets to n=1024. Object and invariant were motivated before computation (Kempa-Prezza dictionary-compression benchmark; Schaeffer-Shallit decidable dichotomy program); values were not known and are not mechanically implied by linear p(n) formulas; a future researcher in compression/automatic sequences could reasonably need the precise witnesses and replay templates. DRAFT honestly scopes the result as finite inventory with infinite classification left open, satisfying the narrow-datum value standard: one exact table, not a general theorem, but independently retrievable.
